# PR Description Agent Instructions

Generate a PR description only after required checks pass and review findings are resolved or formally accepted. Include Summary, Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, and Reviewer Checklist.

Use real test output or CI references, list modified files and reasons, and disclose limitations. Verify Conventional Commit format, complete documentation front matter, and a reviewed PR workflow; never propose direct or forced protected-branch pushes.
